summary: First-pass full review of SourceLess Sand Garage. Backend: 19/19 pytest pass (auth, cars CRUD with user-scoping, diagnostics PDF upload via Gemini, history, global search, cleanup-on-delete). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): demo login prefilled & works, Garage list with critical alerts banner & demo BMW M3 shown, Car Detail screen renders hero photo + specs grid + diagnostic history + sticky Upload Xtool PDF button, Add Car form validates required fields ('Producer, Model, Year and Plate Number are required.'), new car persists & appears in list, Diagnostics tab shows search input and 'No trouble codes match' empty-state, Profile shows user info + LOG OUT which correctly returns to /login.

issues: Non-blocking React warning in console: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (RN Web). Originates from a Pressable usage; harmless but worth cleaning.

action_items: (Optional) Replace any `pointerEvents` prop on Pressable/View with `style={{ pointerEvents: ... }}` to silence the RN Web deprecation warning.
Expo SDK reports minor version drift (expo 54.0.34 vs 54.0.35, expo-font 14.0.11 vs 14.0.12, expo-router 6.0.23 vs 6.0.24). Not blocking but consider `npx expo install --check`.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~470 lines and still single-file; acceptable now but split into routers (auth/cars/diagnostics) before it grows.
JWT_SECRET_KEY default in .env is a placeholder ('change_in_prod_2026') — flag for production.
All Mongo queries already exclude _id and are user-scoped; cars DELETE cascades into diagnostics. Good.
DTC extraction has a robust JSON-parse + regex fallback path.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed users/cars and self-clean (delete car at end + post-UI cleanup loop deletes any TEST_ producer cars).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL) from /app/frontend/.env. Login submit testID is `login-submit-button`. Add-car field testIDs use prefix `field-` (field-producer/model/year/engine/plate/insurance/mot/tyres/colour). Card rows: `car-card-<id>`. Upload PDF button: `upload-pdf-button`.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no functional defects found in this iteration.
